text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy with Chrono Genesis—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis!
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Reporter Otonashi...!
Hello. Are you here for an interview?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We just finished.
...I'm so glad I ran into you!
I really wanted to thank you, Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes! Actually, Chrono-san provided us with race photos the other day!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It was very well received within the company too!
They said, 'It feels like the pulse of the Umamusume is coming right through!'

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much!
I'm truly honored...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I was also able to get some valuable feedback regarding the race,
it was truly a meaningful time...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No! The pleasure is mine...!
...Ah, that reminds me.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually, regarding the Umamusume we were talking about back then,
I just happened to find some new materials yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
! Really?!
...Please, tell me more!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
“—An essay by a retired Trainer...!
I totally overlooked this!”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Reading this essay...
it seems her pre-race dancing routine
was taught to her by him during their club days.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. I had heard rumors that it was your mentor's influence... but it was true after all!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There are actually a few other retired Trainers
who have published essays...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The book I'm reading right now is one of them.
...I believe it was on this page—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'll take a look!
choice_data_list: (Wow, giving information to a pro reporter...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Well, actually, under the pen name 'Writer C,' she runs a column in the school newspaper called 'Idle Talks on History.'
choice_data_list: (The content is surprisingly thorough and authentic, too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thinking about it that way, their fiery passion made total sense. But as I watched over them with a warm feeling—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The sun had set before I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry!
I ended up overstaying my welcome...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It was very meaningful for me as well...!
To be able to talk like this with a reporter whose
articles I always read...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The article... Come to think of it, Chrono-san,
have you taken a look at that?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the Tracen Academy school paper column,
"Idle Historical Musings"!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh, u-um... well, yes.
I did look through it... for the most part!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!
You already checked it out!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I read it after a staff member recommended it to me, and I was so, so deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Not only is the information accurate, but what's truly wonderful is that elevated perspective!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
From the past to the present, and into the future...!
The sheer passion of this continuously woven drama is incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I can feel a deep conviction in that column!
A strong conviction to preserve the history of Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But I wonder,
who is the one writing this?
If only they could contribute an article to our company—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-You startled me...
choice_data_list: Was it okay not to give your name?
Was it okay not to give your name?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
It's something I write partly as a hobby, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Besides, well... a-anymore than that would be...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Capacity overload...
choice_data_list: Though no amount of praise could ever be enough...
I mean, you're even using a pen name and all.
I mean, you're even using a pen name and all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Capacity overload...
choice_data_list: Though no amount of praise could ever be enough...
I mean, you're even using a pen name and all.
I mean, you're even using a pen name and all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!?
choice_data_list: First of all, the column title is great, right? And also...
First of all, the column title is great, and also...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: P-P-Please wait! Right now... my heart is just so completely full...!
choice_data_list: Your word choice is so precise and passionate—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: J-Jeez! Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... The reason I started writing articles wasn't to make a name for myself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because I wanted to preserve the history woven at this academy...
as a picture scroll.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...The history before the bloom is delicate; if no one discovers it, it will simply decay away."
